parameters.name: X-Fc-Account-Id
parameters.description: The ID of your Alibaba Cloud account.

parameters.name: X-Fc-Date
parameters.description: The time when the operation is called. The format is: **EEE,d MMM yyyy HH:mm:ss GMT**.

parameters.name: X-Fc-Trace-Id
parameters.description: The trace ID of the request for Function Compute API.

parameters.name: layerName
parameters.description: The layer name. You can query only custom layer versions. You cannot query versions of official public layers.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The maximum number of resources to return. Default value: 20. The value cannot exceed 100. The number of returned configurations is less than or equal to the specified number.

parameters.name: startVersion
parameters.description: The initial version of the layer.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun fc-open list-layer-versions --layer-name MyLayer --start-version 1 --limit 20 --x-fc-account-id 1880770869020000 --x-fc-date Wed,_11_May_2022_09:00:00_GMT --x-fc-trace-id rid281s000000 --api-version 2021-04-06 --region cn-hangzhou
